```{ojs}
//| output: false
{
  // collapse toggle for the floating TOC panel (climateRationale pattern):
  // starts collapsed on narrow viewports so the fixed panel never overlaps
  // the 1180px content column; the user's click pins their choice.
  const NARROW = 1480;
  if (!document.body.classList.contains("atlas-toc-collapsed") &&
      !document.body.dataset.atlasTocUserChose &&
      window.innerWidth < NARROW) {
    document.body.classList.add("atlas-toc-collapsed");
  }
  if (!document.querySelector(".atlas-toc-toggle")) {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "atlas-toc-toggle";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Toggle table of contents");
    btn.setAttribute("title", "Show/hide table of contents");
    const render = () => {
      btn.textContent = document.body.classList.contains("atlas-toc-collapsed") ? "☰" : "×";
    };
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.body.classList.toggle("atlas-toc-collapsed");
      document.body.dataset.atlasTocUserChose = "1";
      render();
    });
    render();
    document.body.appendChild(btn);
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
// County-at-a-glance tiles. All values computed live from served parquets.
glanceCard = {
  const phase = currentState.phase;
  const chipColor = phase === "El Niño" ? PALETTE.phase.elnino
    : phase === "La Niña" ? PALETTE.phase.lanina : "#8a8a8a";
  const statusTxt = phase === "El Niño" ? _lang(nbText.sections.glance.statusEl)
    : phase === "La Niña" ? _lang(nbText.sections.glance.statusLa)
    : _lang(nbText.sections.glance.statusNeutral);
  const iodTxt = currentState.dmi == null ? ""
    : currentState.dmi > 0.4 ? _lang(nbText.sections.glance.iodPos)
    : currentState.dmi < -0.4 ? _lang(nbText.sections.glance.iodNeg)
    : _lang(nbText.sections.glance.iodNeu);
  const o = glanceOutlook;
  const oColor = o == null ? "#8a8a8a"
    : o.modal === "Wet" ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter
    : o.modal === "Dry" ? PALETTE.outcome.drier : "#8a8a8a";
  const oWord = o == null ? "—" : o.modal === "Wet" ? "leaning wetter" : o.modal === "Dry" ? "leaning drier" : "no strong lean";
  const ls = lastSeasonAnom;
  const lsColor = ls == null ? "#8a8a8a" : ls.pct >= 0 ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : PALETTE.outcome.drier;
  const v = vopSummary;
  const fmtI = (x) => x >= 1e9 ? (x / 1e9).toFixed(1) + " bn" : x >= 1e6 ? (x / 1e6).toFixed(0) + " m" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString();
  return html`<div class="ke-glance">
    <div class="ke-tile">
      <div class="ke-tile-label">${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.tileState)}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-main"><span class="ke-chip" style="background:${chipColor}">${phase === "neutral" ? "Neutral" : phase}</span></div>
      <div class="ke-tile-sub">${statusTxt}${iodTxt ? "; " + iodTxt : ""} — ${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.dataThrough)} ${staleness.label}${staleness.level !== "fresh" ? html` · <b style="color:#c0392b">${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.staleNote)}</b>` : ""}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ke-tile">
      <div class="ke-tile-label">${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.tileOutlook)} · ${county}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-main" style="color:${signalsMixed ? "#d95f0e" : oColor}">${signalsMixed ? "mixed signals" : oWord}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-sub">${o == null ? "no baseline for this county"
        : signalsMixed ? html`ENSO history leans ${oWord} but the IOD disagrees — <a href="#outlook">see the outlook</a>`
        : html`${o.counts[o.modal]} of ${o.n} similar past years — <a href="#outlook">see the outlook</a>`}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ke-tile">
      <div class="ke-tile-label">${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.tileLast)} · ${county}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-main" style="color:${lsColor}">${ls == null ? "—" : (ls.pct >= 0 ? "+" : "") + Math.round(ls.pct) + "%"}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-sub">${ls == null ? "no data" : `Oct–Dec ${ls.year} vs the county's normal`}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="ke-tile">
      <div class="ke-tile-label">${_lang(nbText.sections.glance.tileVop)} · ${county}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-main">I$ ${v == null ? "—" : fmtI(v.total)}</div>
      <div class="ke-tile-sub">${v == null ? "" : `${Math.round(v.livestockShare * 100)}% livestock · top: ${v.top}`}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// County click-picker: d3-drawn choropleth. Clicking a county writes the
// sticky-bar county select (single source of truth) and dispatches input.
countyPickerMap = {
  const W = 640, H = 560;
  const def = pickerMetricDefs[mapMetric];
  const values = pickerMetrics.get(def.key);
  const proj = d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[8, 8], [W - 8, H - 8]],
    {type: "FeatureCollection", features: kenyaA1});
  const path = d3.geoPath(proj);
  const vals = kenyaA1.map((f) => values.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code)).filter((v) => v != null);
  const scale = def.scale(vals);
  const svgEl = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W).attr("style", "max-width:100%;height:auto;cursor:pointer;")
    .attr("role", "group")
    .attr("aria-label", "Map of Kenya counties; click or focus a county and press Enter to select it");
  // topo names drift from the canonical 47 (Elgeyo-Marakwet / Murang'A /
  // Tharaka-Nithi) and Ilemi Triangle is not a county — resolve every click
  // and highlight through gaul1_code (R2 fix).
  const pick = (f) => {
    const name = gaulToCounty.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
    if (name == null) return; // Ilemi Triangle: inert
    const sel = viewof county;
    sel.value = name;
    sel.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  svgEl.selectAll("path").data(kenyaA1).join("path")
    .attr("d", path)
    .attr("fill", (f) => {
      const v = values.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      return v == null ? "#f0f0ec" : scale(v);
    })
    .attr("stroke", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? "#111" : "#fff")
    .attr("stroke-width", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? 2.2 : 0.6)
    .attr("tabindex", (f) => gaulToCounty.has(+f.properties.gaul1_code) ? 0 : null)
    .attr("role", (f) => gaulToCounty.has(+f.properties.gaul1_code) ? "button" : null)
    .attr("aria-label", (f) => {
      const name = gaulToCounty.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      if (name == null) return null;
      const v = values.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      return `${name}: ${v == null ? "no data" : def.fmt(v)} — press Enter to select`;
    })
    .on("click", (ev, f) => pick(f))
    .on("keydown", (ev, f) => {
      if (ev.key === "Enter" || ev.key === " ") { ev.preventDefault(); pick(f); }
    })
    .append("title")
    .text((f) => {
      const name = gaulToCounty.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code) ?? f.properties.admin1_name;
      const v = values.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      return `${name}: ${v == null ? "no data" : def.fmt(v)}`;
    });
  // selected county drawn last so its outline sits on top
  svgEl.selectAll("path").filter((f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul).raise();
  const legend = Plot.legend({color: {type: def.legendType ?? "linear",
    domain: scale.domain(), range: def.legendType === "ordinal" ? scale.range() : undefined,
    interpolate: def.legendType === "ordinal" ? undefined : ((t) => scale(scale.domain()[0] + t * (scale.domain()[scale.domain().length - 1] - scale.domain()[0]))),
    label: mapMetric}, width: 320});
  return html`<div>${svgEl.node()}${legend}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
  renderToDiv("plotProduce", () => {
    if (prodView === "Table") return prodViewTable();
```

```{ojs}
// Interactive GESI table (Pete P7): filter by rank extremity (default =
// stand-out only), rank chips coloured by extremity, 47-county strip kept.
gesiRiskCard = {
  const standOut = gesiFilter.startsWith("Stand-out");
  const rows0 = gesiSeries.filter((s) => s.cv != null && s.rank != null)
    .map((s) => ({...s, extremity: Math.min(s.rank, s.n - s.rank + 1)}));
  const shown = standOut ? rows0.filter((s) => s.extremity <= 10).sort((a, b) => a.extremity - b.extremity)
                         : rows0;
  if (!shown.length) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No GESI indicators reported for ${county}.</div>`;
  const W = 300, H = 20, x = (pv) => 8 + pv * (W - 16);
  const fmt = (v) => v == null ? "—" : (Math.abs(v) >= 100 ? Math.round(v).toLocaleString() : +v.toFixed(1));
  const jit = (i) => H / 2 + Math.sin(i * 2.399963) * 3.5;
  const strip = (sr) => svg`<svg width=${W} height=${H} viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="overflow:visible">
      <line x1=${x(0)} y1=${H / 2} x2=${x(1)} y2=${H / 2} stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
      <g>${sr.dots.filter((d) => !d.sel).map((d, i) => svg`<circle cx=${x(d.pos)} cy=${jit(i)} r="2" fill="#8a8a8a" fill-opacity="0.6"/>`)}</g>
      <path d=${`M ${x(sr.posK)} 4 L ${x(sr.posK) + 4} ${H / 2} L ${x(sr.posK)} ${H - 4} L ${x(sr.posK) - 4} ${H / 2} Z`} fill="white" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx=${x(sr.dots.find((d) => d.sel)?.pos ?? 0.5)} cy=${H / 2} r="4.6" fill="#2c7fb8" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </svg>`;
  const chip = (sr) => {
    const hot = sr.extremity <= 5 ? "#d95f0e" : sr.extremity <= 10 ? "#e8a838" : "#8a8a8a";
    return html`<span style="display:inline-block;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:${hot};color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums" title="rank ${sr.rank} of ${sr.n} counties (1 = highest value)">${sr.rank}/${sr.n}</span>`;
  };
  const trs = shown.map((sr) => html`<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #f2f2f2">
    <td style="padding:5px 10px 5px 4px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;max-width:280px;white-space:normal">${sr.indicator}</td>
    <td style="text-align:right;font-weight:700;padding:5px 8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${fmt(sr.cv)}</td>
    <td style="text-align:right;color:#777;padding:5px 8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${fmt(sr.kenya)}</td>
    <td style="text-align:center;padding:5px 8px">${chip(sr)}</td>
    <td style="padding:2px 4px" title=${`${county}: ${fmt(sr.cv)} · Kenya: ${fmt(sr.kenya)} · range ${fmt(sr.min)}–${fmt(sr.max)}`}>${strip(sr)}</td>
  </tr>`);
  return html`<figure style="margin:0;max-width:980px">
    <div style="${gesiExpand ? "" : "max-height:520px;overflow:auto;"}border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:6px">
    <table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%">
      <thead><tr style="position:sticky;top:${gesiExpand ? "120px" : "0"};background:white;border-bottom:2px solid #333;text-align:left;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#555">
        <th style="padding:6px 4px">Indicator</th><th style="padding:6px 8px;text-align:right">${county}</th>
        <th style="padding:6px 8px;text-align:right">Kenya</th><th style="padding:6px 8px;text-align:center">Rank</th>
        <th style="padding:6px 8px">All 47 counties</th>
      </tr></thead><tbody>${trs}</tbody></table>
    </div>
    <figcaption style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:5px">
      Rank 1 = highest raw value. Chip colour = extremity only, never good/bad:
      <span style="background:#d95f0e;color:#fff;padding:0 6px;border-radius:8px">top/bottom 5</span>
      <span style="background:#e8a838;color:#fff;padding:0 6px;border-radius:8px">top/bottom 10</span>
      <span style="background:#8a8a8a;color:#fff;padding:0 6px;border-radius:8px">mid-range</span> ·
      <span style="color:#2c7fb8;font-weight:700">●</span> ${county} · ◇ Kenya national · grey dots = other counties.
    </figcaption>
  </figure>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Per-phase season means, computed live (deterministic aggregation).
phaseChips = {
  if (rainTimeRes.startsWith("Month")) return html``;
  const chips = rainActiveSeasons.flatMap((s) => {
    const {rows, clim} = rainSeasonData.get(s);
    const isMAM = s === "MAM";
    const groups = isMAM
      ? [{key: "wnp", p: "Western-V high"}, {key: "wnp", p: "Western-V low"}]
      : [{key: "enso", p: "El Niño"}, {key: "enso", p: "La Niña"},
         {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD positive"}, {key: "iodPhase", p: "IOD negative"}];
    return groups.map(({key, p}) => {
      const sub = rows.filter((r) => r[key] === p);
      if (sub.length < 3) return null;
      const m = d3.mean(sub, (r) => r.value) - (varIsAnom ? 0 : 0);
      const dev = d3.mean(sub, (r) => r.value) - clim;
      const col = varIsTemp
        ? (dev >= 0 ? PALETTE.impact.bad : "#4575b4")
        : (dev >= 0 ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : PALETTE.outcome.drier);
      const lbl = varIsSpei ? m.toFixed(2) : `${dev >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${varIsTemp ? dev.toFixed(1) + " °C" : Math.round(dev) + " mm"}`;
      return html`<span style="display:inline-block;margin:2px 8px 2px 0;padding:2px 10px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;font-size:12.5px">
        ${seasonWord(s)} · ${p}: <b style="color:${col}">${varIsSpei ? "SPEI " + lbl : lbl + " vs normal"}</b> <span style="color:#999">(${sub.length} years)</span></span>`;
    }).filter(Boolean);
  });
  return chips.length ? html`<div style="margin:0.25rem 0"><span style="font-size:12px;color:#666">${_lang(nbText.sections.b2.phaseChipsNote)}</span><br>${chips}</div>` : html``;
}
```

```{ojs}

```

```{ojs}

```

```{ojs}

  label: _lang(nbText.sections.controls.rowShape), value: "Equal rows",
})
```

:::

```{ojs}
// one contingency panel per season, grouped by the chosen driver's intensity
// classes (aligned with the dev_rainfall_maps Z_BANDS system)
contRows = (season, driver) => {
  const y0 = Math.min(contYearFrom, contYearTo), y1 = Math.max(contYearFrom, contYearTo);
  const zm = zSeries(driver, season);
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  const rows = outlookBase.filter((r) => r.season === season && r.gaul1_code === selGaul
    && r.year >= y0 && r.year <= y1);
  // rebinned per Pete (V2-10): neutral/weak (<1 sd) | moderate (1–1.5) |
  // strong (≥1.5); z ranges printed in the labels; small-n groups shown
  // with a * instead of being silently hidden.
  const split = contDetail;
  const groupOf = (year) => {
    const z = zm.get(year);
    if (z == null) return null;
    const a = Math.abs(z);
    if (!split) return a >= Z_BANDS.moderate ? `${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg} (≥1 sd)` : "Neutral / weak (<1 sd)";
    if (a >= Z_BANDS.strong) return `Strong ${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg} (≥1.5 sd)`;
    if (a >= Z_BANDS.moderate) return `Moderate ${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg} (1–1.5 sd)`;
    return "Neutral / weak (<1 sd)";
  };
  const groups = split
    ? [`Strong ${def.pos} (≥1.5 sd)`, `Moderate ${def.pos} (1–1.5 sd)`,
       "Neutral / weak (<1 sd)",
       `Moderate ${def.neg} (1–1.5 sd)`, `Strong ${def.neg} (≥1.5 sd)`, "All years"]
    : [`${def.pos} (≥1 sd)`, "Neutral / weak (<1 sd)", `${def.neg} (≥1 sd)`, "All years"];
  const out = [];
  const push = (group, sub) => {
    const total = sub.length;
    if (total < 1) return;
    let x0 = 0;
    for (const t of ["Wet", "Near", "Dry"]) {
      const count = sub.filter((r) => r.tercile === t).length;
      const share = count / total;
      out.push({season, driver, group,
        // small-n is a FLAG, never baked into the group name: the two panels
        // share one row domain (V2-44a) and a star in the key would split it
        small: total < 4,
        outcome: t === "Wet" ? "Wetter" : t === "Near" ? "Near-normal" : "Drier",
        count, total, share, mid: x0 + share / 2});
      x0 += share;
    }
  };
  for (const g of groups) {
    if (g === "All years") push(g, rows);
    else push(g, rows.filter((r) => groupOf(r.year) === g));
  }
  const unclassified = rows.filter((r) => groupOf(r.year) == null).length;
  return {out, unclassified, nAll: rows.length, groups};
}
// V2-44a: both panels share ONE height and ONE row pitch (passed in by
// contingencyChart) so their rows line up straight across; the colour legend
// is rendered once above the pair rather than inside the left panel (which
// used to push that panel down and break the alignment it was meant to have).
// Each panel keeps its OWN band labels — the two seasons usually run
// different drivers, so a shared label domain would fill half of each panel
// with the other driver's empty bands.
// V2-44c: "Mosaic" mode gives each row a height proportional to the number of
// seasons in that band — visual weight then matches the evidence behind it.
contingencyPanel = (season, driver, opts = {}) => {
  const {out, unclassified, nAll} = contRows(season, driver);
  if (!nAll) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No record for ${county} (${season}).</div>`;
  if (out.length <= 3) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">Only the all-years row has data for ${driver} (${season}) — no season carries a driver value.</div>`;
  const rowDomain = opts.groups ?? [...new Set(out.map((d) => d.group))];
  const H = opts.height ?? (90 + rowDomain.length * 34);
  const smallSet = new Set(out.filter((d) => d.small).map((d) => d.group));
  const totalOf = new Map(out.map((d) => [d.group, d.total]));
  const emptyRows = rowDomain.filter((g) => !totalOf.has(g)).map((g) => ({group: g}));
  const lbl = (g) => wrapTickLabel(g + (smallSet.has(g) ? " *" : ""), 16);
  const nSeasons = (n) => `${n} season${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
  // ONE small-n rule for both row shapes: never print a bold share on a band
  // the same panel simultaneously calls an anecdote (the "*" cut is < 4).
  const LABEL_MIN_N = 4;
  const pctRows = out.filter((d) => d.share >= 0.12 && d.total >= LABEL_MIN_N);
  const common = {
    width: 460, marginLeft: 170, marginRight: 58,
    x: {label: "share of that band's seasons", tickFormat: ".0%", domain: [0, 1]},
    color: {domain: ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"],
      range: [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier], legend: false},
  };
  let plot;
  if (contShape.startsWith("Mosaic")) {
    // Bands stacked in canonical order with height ∝ seasons. Three rules keep
    // the mode honest (all three were review findings on the first cut):
    //  1. the y domain is REVERSED — a quantitative scale puts domain[0] at the
    //     BOTTOM, which would mirror the whole figure against "Equal rows";
    //  2. "All years" is NOT a row here — at 1/10 scale it drew 35 seasons
    //     shorter than a 4-season band. The base rate is shown instead as two
    //     reference rules across the stack, at zero height cost;
    //  3. labels are single-line and drawn only where the row can hold one —
    //     a wrapped 3-line label on a 7px row lands in its neighbours. Rows too
    //     thin to label keep their name in the hover.
    const bands = rowDomain.filter((g) => g !== "All years");
    const bandTotal = d3.sum(bands, (g) => totalOf.get(g) ?? 0);
    const EMPTY_U = Math.max(0.6, bandTotal * 0.012); // a sliver, NOT a season-sized slot
    const pos = new Map();
    let stackEnd = 0;
    for (const g of bands) {
      const h = totalOf.has(g) ? totalOf.get(g) : EMPTY_U;
      pos.set(g, [stackEnd, stackEnd + h]);
      stackEnd += h;
    }
    // both panels share one unit extent so a season is the same height on each
    const yEnd = Math.max(opts.yEnd ?? 0, stackEnd) || 1;
    const pxPerUnit = (H - 44) / yEnd;
    const fits = (g) => (pos.get(g)[1] - pos.get(g)[0]) * pxPerUnit >= 12;
    const shortLbl = (g) => g.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "") + (smallSet.has(g) ? " *" : "");
    const withPos = (rows) => rows.filter((d) => pos.has(d.group))
      .map((d) => ({...d, y1: pos.get(d.group)[0], y2: pos.get(d.group)[1],
        yc: (pos.get(d.group)[0] + pos.get(d.group)[1]) / 2,
        x1: d.mid - d.share / 2, x2: d.mid + d.share / 2}));
    const rects = withPos(out);
    const labels = withPos([...new Map(out.map((d) => [d.group, d])).values(),
      ...emptyRows.map((d) => ({...d, mid: 0, share: 0}))]);
    const roomy = labels.filter((d) => fits(d.group));
    const base = out.filter((d) => d.group === "All years");
    const cum = [];
    let acc = 0;
    for (const o of ["Wetter", "Near-normal"]) {
      const b = base.find((d) => d.outcome === o);
      if (b) { acc += b.share; cum.push(acc); }
    }
    plot = Plot.plot({
      ...common, height: H, marginTop: 14,
      y: {domain: [yEnd, 0], axis: null},
      marks: [
        Plot.rect(rects, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "outcome",
          insetTop: 0.5, insetBottom: 0.5, // vertical hairline only — the x encoding stays exact
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.total < 5 ? 0.55 : 1,
          title: (d) => `${d.group}\n${d.outcome}: ${d.count} of ${nSeasons(d.total)} (${Math.round(d.share * 100)}%)`, tip: true}),
        Plot.text(withPos(pctRows).filter((d) => fits(d.group)), {x: "mid", y: "yc",
          text: (d) => Math.round(d.share * 100) + "%", fill: "#fff", fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600}),
        Plot.text(roomy, {x: 0, y: "yc", text: (d) => shortLbl(d.group), dx: -8,
          textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 10.5, fill: "#333"}),
        Plot.text(roomy.filter((d) => totalOf.has(d.group)), {x: 1, y: "yc",
          text: (d) => nSeasons(totalOf.get(d.group)), dx: 40, fill: "#777", fontSize: 10.5}),
        Plot.text(roomy.filter((d) => !totalOf.has(d.group)), {x: 0, y: "yc",
          text: () => "no seasons in this band", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#aaa", fontSize: 10}),
        // base rate across every season, as rules rather than a scaled row
        Plot.ruleX(cum, {stroke: "#333", strokeDasharray: "4,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      ],
    });
  } else {
    plot = Plot.plot({
      ...common, height: H,
      y: {domain: rowDomain, label: null, tickFormat: lbl},
      marks: [
        Plot.barX(out, {x: "share", y: "group", fill: "outcome", order: ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"],
          fillOpacity: (d) => d.total < 5 ? 0.55 : 1,
          title: (d) => `${d.group}\n${d.outcome}: ${d.count} of ${nSeasons(d.total)} (${Math.round(d.share * 100)}%)`, tip: true}),
        Plot.text(pctRows, {x: "mid", y: "group",
          text: (d) => Math.round(d.share * 100) + "%", fill: "#fff", fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: 600}),
        Plot.text(out.filter((d) => d.outcome === "Drier"), {x: 1, y: "group",
          text: (d) => nSeasons(d.total), dx: 40, fill: "#777", fontSize: 10.5}),
        // a band with no seasons in THIS season must not read as a zero share
        Plot.text(emptyRows, {x: 0, y: "group", text: () => "no seasons in this band",
          dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#aaa", fontSize: 10}),
      ],
    });
  }
  const faded = out.some((d) => d.total < 5);
  const baseRow = out.filter((d) => d.group === "All years");
  const baseTxt = baseRow.length
    ? `base rate, all ${nSeasons(baseRow[0].total)}: ` +
      baseRow.map((d) => `${Math.round(d.share * 100)}% ${d.outcome.toLowerCase()}`).join(" · ")
    : "";
  const note = html`<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888">
    ${smallSet.size ? "* fewer than 4 seasons — read as anecdote, not evidence. " : ""}
    ${faded ? "Faded rows rest on fewer than 5 seasons. " : ""}
    ${contShape.startsWith("Mosaic") ? html`Dashed rules mark the ${baseTxt} — read each row against them. Rows too thin to label are named on hover. ` : ""}
    ${unclassified > 0 ? `${unclassified} season${unclassified > 1 ? "s" : ""} without a driver value appear only in “All years”.` : ""}</div>`;
  return html`<div>${plot}${note}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
contingencyChart = {
  // ONE height and one row pitch across both panels (V2-44a). Both panels
  // always carry the same NUMBER of bands (the band structure is symmetric
  // and contDetail is global), so equal height ⇒ rows line up; each panel
  // keeps its own driver's labels. A band with no seasons says so.
  const ondR = contRows("OND", contOndDriver), mamR = contRows("MAM", contMamDriver);
  const rowCount = Math.max((ondR.groups ?? []).length, (mamR.groups ?? []).length, 1);
  // mosaic layout units per panel (bands only — "All years" is not a row
  // there); both panels are drawn on the LARGER extent so one season is the
  // same height on each, and a panel with fewer classified seasons simply
  // leaves space at the bottom rather than silently using a bigger scale.
  const unitsOf = (r) => {
    const tot = new Map(r.out.filter((d) => d.group !== "All years").map((d) => [d.group, d.total]));
    const bands = (r.groups ?? []).filter((g) => g !== "All years");
    const bandTotal = d3.sum(bands, (g) => tot.get(g) ?? 0);
    const empty = Math.max(0.6, bandTotal * 0.012);
    return d3.sum(bands, (g) => tot.has(g) ? tot.get(g) : empty);
  };
  const yEnd = Math.max(unitsOf(ondR), unitsOf(mamR), 1);
  // aim for ~12 px per season so single-line row labels fit; clamped
  const height = contShape.startsWith("Mosaic")
    ? Math.max(260, Math.min(620, 44 + yEnd * 12))
    : 90 + rowCount * 34;
  const opts = contShape.startsWith("Mosaic") ? {height, yEnd} : {height};
  return html`<div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;margin:0 0 0.3rem">
      <span style="font-size:11px;color:#555">Season outcome:</span>
      ${Plot.legend({color: {domain: ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"],
        range: [PALETTE.outcome.wetter, PALETTE.outcome.near, PALETTE.outcome.drier]}})}
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start">
      <div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">OND (short rains) — ${contOndDriver}</div>${contingencyPanel("OND", contOndDriver, {...opts, groups: ondR.groups})}</div>
      <div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">MAM (long rains) — ${contMamDriver}</div>${contingencyPanel("MAM", contMamDriver, {...opts, groups: mamR.groups})}</div>
    </div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
plotFooter(_lang(nbText.sections.b2.contingencyCaption), contingencyChart, {
  fig: "2.2",
  about: _lang(nbText.sections.b2.contingencyAbout),
  filename: `${county}_tercile_by_driver`,
  data: (() => {
    // include canonical bands with no seasons as explicit zero rows, and flag
    // the all-years reference so a naive sum cannot double-count the record
    const rs = [contRows("OND", contOndDriver), contRows("MAM", contMamDriver)];
    const rows = rs.flatMap((r) => {
      const seen = new Set(r.out.map((d) => d.group));
      const season = r.out[0]?.season, driver = r.out[0]?.driver;
      const empties = (r.groups ?? []).filter((g) => !seen.has(g)).flatMap((g) =>
        ["Wetter", "Near-normal", "Drier"].map((o) => ({season, driver, group: g, outcome: o,
          count: 0, total: 0, share: null, small: true})));
      return [...r.out, ...empties];
    });
    return rows.map((d) => ({season: d.season, driver: d.driver, group: d.group,
      row_type: d.group === "All years" ? "all_years_reference" : "band",
      outcome: d.outcome, count: d.count, total: d.total,
      share: d.share == null ? null : +d.share.toFixed(3), small_n: d.small}));
  })(),
  meta: {Source: "CHIRPS v3 county terciles + NOAA driver indices",
    County: county, Drivers: `${contOndDriver} / ${contMamDriver}`,
    Period: `${Math.min(contYearFrom, contYearTo)}–${Math.max(contYearFrom, contYearTo)}`},
})
```

```{ojs}
// per-season greenness grouped by driver-intensity bins (strong vs
// moderate/weak — Pete P21b), OND left / MAM right (P31)
ndviSwarmPanel = (season) => {
  const months = season === "OND" ? [10, 11, 12] : [3, 4, 5];
  const driver = season === "OND" ? "ENSO + IOD" : "Western-V (WNP)";
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  const zm = zSeries(driver, season);
  const by = d3.rollups(ndviCty.filter((d) => months.includes(d.month)),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal), (d) => d.year)
    .map(([year, ndvi]) => ({year, ndvi, z: zm.get(year) ?? null}))
    .filter((d) => d.ndvi != null && d.z != null);
  if (by.length < 5) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">Too little NDVI data (${season}).</div>`;
  const bins = [`Strong ${def.pos}`, `Moderate ${def.pos}`, "Neutral / weak", `Moderate ${def.neg}`, `Strong ${def.neg}`];
  const rows = by.map((d) => ({...d, bin: swarmBinOf(def, d.z)}));
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 330, width: 460, marginLeft: 55, marginBottom: 60, grid: true,
    x: {domain: bins.filter((b) => rows.some((r) => r.bin === b)),
        tickFormat: (b) => wrapTickLabel(b, 11), label: `${driver.replace(/ \(.*\)$/, "")} state that season`},
    y: {label: "season mean NDVI (% of normal)"},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
      Plot.dot(rows, {x: "bin", y: "ndvi", fill: (d) => cardColor(d.z), stroke: "#666", strokeWidth: 0.6, r: 5,
        tip: true, title: (d) => `${d.year}: ${d.ndvi.toFixed(0)}% of normal · ${categoryOf(driver, d.z)}`}),
      Plot.text(rows, {x: "bin", y: "ndvi", text: (d) => String(d.year), dx: 15, fontSize: 9, fill: "#555"}),
      Plot.tickY(rows, Plot.groupX({y: "median"}, {x: "bin", y: "ndvi", stroke: "#111", strokeWidth: 2.5})),
    ],
  });
}
swarmBinOf = (def, z) => {
  const a = Math.abs(z);
  if (a >= Z_BANDS.strong) return `Strong ${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg}`;
  if (a >= Z_BANDS.moderate) return `Moderate ${z > 0 ? def.pos : def.neg}`;
  return "Neutral / weak";
}
ndviSwarmRows = (season) => {
  const months = season === "OND" ? [10, 11, 12] : [3, 4, 5];
  const driver = season === "OND" ? "ENSO + IOD" : "Western-V (WNP)";
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  const zm = zSeries(driver, season);
  return d3.rollups(ndviCty.filter((d) => months.includes(d.month)),
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal), (d) => d.year)
    .map(([year, ndvi]) => ({season, driver, year, ndvi: ndvi == null ? null : +ndvi.toFixed(1),
      z: zm.get(year) == null ? null : +zm.get(year).toFixed(2),
      bin: zm.get(year) == null ? "no index" : swarmBinOf(def, zm.get(year))}))
    .filter((d) => d.ndvi != null);
}
ndviSwarmExport = [...ndviSwarmRows("OND"), ...(showMamSwarm ? ndviSwarmRows("MAM") : [])]
ndviPhaseChart = html`<div style="display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start">
  <div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">OND (short rains)</div>${ndviSwarmPanel("OND")}</div>
  ${showMamSwarm ? html`<div><div class="ke-panel-lbl">MAM (long rains)</div>${ndviSwarmPanel("MAM")}</div>` : ""}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
// what counts as a dry/wet season HERE: the county's tercile cutoffs (mm)
tercThresholdLine = {
  // MUST match the producer: enso_outlook_base terciles = np.percentile(1991–2020, [33.3, 66.7])
  // (linear interpolation — d3.quantile is the same R-7 method; verified 45/45 agreement)
  const vals = chirpsYearlyAll.filter((d) => d.period === lensSeasonCode && d.value != null
      && d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020)
    .map((d) => d.value).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  if (vals.length < 25) return html``;
  const lo = d3.quantile(vals, 1 / 3), hi = d3.quantile(vals, 2 / 3);
  return html`<div style="font-size:13px;color:#444;border-left:4px solid #94a89a;background:#f5f8f5;padding:8px 12px;margin:0 0 0.6rem;max-width:62rem">
    In <b>${county}</b>, a <b>drier-than-usual</b> ${seasonWord(lensSeasonCode).toLowerCase()} season means
    <b>${Math.round(lo)} mm</b> or less; <b>wetter than usual</b> means more than <b>${Math.round(hi)} mm</b>
    (the driest and wettest thirds of 1991–2020 — the baseline behind every season category in this
    section, and the same categories as a KMD “depressed / enhanced rainfall” outlook).</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// seasonal PTOT for the compare set (data input: county list)
chirpsYearlyCmp = {
  const names = (rainCmpCounties.length ? rainCmpCounties : [county]);
  const inList = names.map((c) => `'${countyNorm(c)}'`).join(", ");
  const rows = await dbChirps.query(`
    SELECT admin1_name AS raw, period, year, value_mean AS value FROM chirps_county
    WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} IN (${inList})
      AND variable = 'PTOT' AND period IN ('OND', 'MAM') ORDER BY year`);
  const canon = new Map(names.map((c) => [countyNorm(c), c]));
  return rows.filter((d) => d.value != null)
    .map((d) => ({county: canon.get(countyNorm(d.raw)) ?? d.raw, period: d.period, year: d.year, value: d.value}));
}
```

```{ojs}
seasonStripChart = {
  if (!speiRows.length) return noDataPlaceholder(`No SPEI record for ${county}.`);
  const y1v = d3.min(speiRows, (d) => d.v), y2v = d3.max(speiRows, (d) => d.v);
  const from = d3.min(speiRows, (d) => d.t), to = d3.max(speiRows, (d) => d.t);
  // break the line/area wherever a month is missing (December is quarantined —
  // the NDJ window is corrupt upstream, V2-63): drawing straight through the
  // gap would assert a measurement that does not exist
  const segs = (() => {
    let seg = 0;
    return speiRows.map((d, i) => {
      if (i > 0 && (d.t - speiRows[i - 1].t) / 86400000 > 45) seg++;
      return {...d, seg};
    });
  })();
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 240, width: 900, marginLeft: 55, marginRight: 20,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null},
    y: {label: speiIdx.label},
    marks: [
      ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: y1v, y2: y2v, from, to}),
      ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: y1v, y2: y2v, from, to}),
      Plot.areaY(segs, {x: "t", y1: 0, y2: (d) => Math.min(0, d.v), z: "seg",
        fill: PALETTE.outcome.drier, fillOpacity: 0.45}),
      Plot.lineY(segs, {x: "t", y: "v", z: "seg", stroke: "#555", strokeWidth: 1.1, tip: true,
        title: (d) => `${d.period} ${d.year}: ${speiIdx.v} ${d.v.toFixed(2)}`}),
      Plot.ruleY([-1, -2], {stroke: "#a6611a", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
ndviChart = {

    const dom = [Math.min(90, Math.floor(d3.min(rows, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal) / 10) * 10),
                 Math.max(110, Math.ceil(d3.max(rows, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal) / 10) * 10)];
    const plot = Plot.plot({

      y: {label: "NDVI (% of normal)", domain: dom},

        legend: nm === names[0]},
      marks: [
        ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: dom[0], y2: dom[1], from, to}),
        ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: dom[0], y2: dom[1], from, to}),

          tip: true, title: (d) => `${nm} · ${d.date}: ${d.ndvi_pct_normal.toFixed(0)}% of normal`}),
        Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: "3"}),

    return html`<div>${names.length > 1 ? html`<div class="ke-panel-lbl">${nm}</div>` : ""}${plot}</div>`;
```

```{ojs}
ipcChart = {
  const rows = ipcCty.map((d) => ({...d, t: new Date(d.reporting_date)}));
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No IPC record for ${county}.</div>`;
  const phases = ipcPhases;
  if (ipcView === "Yearly bars") {
    // one bar per year = the WORST phase classified that year, IPC-coloured;
    // driver background sits behind (linear year x so the rects can overlay)
    const byYear = [...d3.rollup(rows, (v) => d3.max(v, (d) => d.max_phase), (d) => d.t.getUTCFullYear())]
      .map(([year, p]) => ({year, p: Math.round(p)})).sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
    const y0 = byYear[0].year, y1 = byYear[byYear.length - 1].year;
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      height: 300, width: 900, marginLeft: 92,
      x: {domain: [y0 - 0.5, y1 + 0.5], tickFormat: "d", label: null},
      y: {domain: [0, 5.5], ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], tickFormat: (p) => phases[p - 1].name, label: null},
      marks: [
        ...bgMarks({x: "year", y1: 0, y2: 5.5, from: y0, to: y1}),
        ...simMarks({x: "year", y1: 0, y2: 5.5, from: y0, to: y1}),
        Plot.rectY(byYear, {x1: (d) => d.year - 0.5, x2: (d) => d.year + 0.5, y: (d) => d.p, insetLeft: 6, insetRight: 6,
          fill: (d) => phases[d.p - 1].c, stroke: "#666", strokeWidth: 0.5, tip: true,
          title: (d) => `${d.year}: worst classification ${phases[d.p - 1].name}`}),
        Plot.ruleY([3], {stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
      ],
    });
    return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
  }
  // Steps view: IPC phase colour bands show ONLY when the driver background
  // is off — the two shadings are mutually exclusive (V2-57)
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 320, width: 900, marginLeft: 92,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null},
    y: {domain: [0.5, 5.5], ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], tickFormat: (p) => phases[p - 1].name, label: null},
    marks: [
      ...(bgMode === "Off"
        ? phases.map((ph) => Plot.rect([ph], {x1: () => rows[0].t, x2: () => rows[rows.length - 1].t,
            y1: () => ph.p - 0.5, y2: () => ph.p + 0.5, fill: () => ph.c, fillOpacity: 0.16}))
        : bgMarks({x: "date", y1: 0.5, y2: 5.5, from: rows[0].t, to: rows[rows.length - 1].t})),
      ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: 0.5, y2: 5.5, from: rows[0].t, to: rows[rows.length - 1].t}),
      Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "t", y: "max_phase", curve: "step-after", stroke: "#7b241c", strokeWidth: 1.8, tip: true,
        title: (d) => `${d.reporting_date}: worst area ${phases[Math.round(d.max_phase) - 1]?.name ?? d.max_phase}`}),
      Plot.ruleY([3], {stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// gap-segmented series (per market), then the selected transform.
pricesSeg = {
  const GAP_DAYS = 100;
  const sel = new Set(priceMarkets);
  const byMkt = d3.group(pricesCty.filter((d) => sel.has(d.market)), (d) => d.market);
  const out = [];
  for (const [mkt, rows] of byMkt) {
    const sorted = rows.map((d) => ({...d, _t: new Date(d.period_date)})).sort((a, b) => a._t - b._t);
    let seg = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (sorted[i]._t - sorted[i - 1]._t) / 86400000 > GAP_DAYS) seg++;
      out.push({...sorted[i], seg: `${mkt}__${seg}`});
    }
  }
  return out;
}

pricesView = {
  if (priceView === "Raw price") return {rows: pricesSeg.map((d) => ({...d, v: d.value_kes})), label: priceUnitLabel, ref: null};
  if (priceView === "Change vs year earlier") {
    const byMkt = d3.group(pricesSeg, (d) => d.market);
    const out = [];
    for (const [, rows] of byMkt) {
      const byKey = new Map(rows.map((d) => [`${d.year}-${d.month}`, d.value_kes]));
      for (const d of rows) {
        const prev = byKey.get(`${d.year - 1}-${d.month}`);
        if (prev != null && prev > 0) out.push({...d, v: (d.value_kes / prev - 1) * 100});
      }
    }
    return {rows: out, label: "% change vs same month a year earlier", ref: 0};
  }
  // Seasonal anomaly: z vs that market's month-of-year climatology.
  const byMkt = d3.group(pricesSeg, (d) => d.market);
  const out = [];
  for (const [, rows] of byMkt) {
    const clim = d3.rollup(rows, (v) => ({m: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.value_kes), s: d3.deviation(v, (d) => d.value_kes)}), (d) => d.month);
    for (const d of rows) {
      const c = clim.get(d.month);
      if (c && c.s > 0) out.push({...d, v: (d.value_kes - c.m) / c.s});
    }
  }
  return {rows: out, label: "departure from the usual level for that month (standard deviations)", ref: 0};
}
```

```{ojs}
pricesChart = {
  const {rows, label, ref} = pricesView;
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div style="color:#666;font-style:italic">No price series for this view.</div>`;
  const from = d3.min(rows, (d) => d._t), to = d3.max(rows, (d) => d._t);
  if (priceAgg !== "Monthly lines") {
    // summary bars: mean of the selected transform across the chosen
    // markets, per quarter/year (V2-58c)
    const bucket = (d) => priceAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d._t.getUTCFullYear(), Math.floor(d._t.getUTCMonth() / 3) * 3, 1);
    const step = priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const agg = [...d3.rollup(rows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.v), n: v.length}), bucket)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + step[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + step[1], 1));
        // a bucket never claims months beyond the last observation
        return {x1: d0, x2: xEnd > dataEnd ? dataEnd : xEnd, partial: xEnd > dataEnd,
          v: o.v, n: o.n};
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);
    const ys = d3.extent(agg, (d) => d.v);
    const yLo = Math.min(0, ys[0]), yHi = Math.max(0, ys[1]);
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      height: 380, width: 900, marginLeft: 60,
      x: {label: null, type: "utc"},
      y: {label: `${label} — mean per ${priceAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "year" : "quarter"} across ${priceMarkets.length} market(s)`},
      marks: [
        ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: yLo, y2: yHi, from, to}),
        ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: yLo, y2: yHi, from, to}),
        Plot.rect(agg, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "v", inset: 1,
          fill: "#5b7fa6", fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.55 : 1, stroke: "#3f5a78", strokeWidth: 0.5, tip: true,
          title: (d) => `${d.x1.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}: ${d.v.toFixed(1)} (mean of ${d.n} market-months${d.partial ? " — period still incomplete" : ""})`}),
        Plot.ruleY([ref ?? 0], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: ref != null ? "3" : null}),
      ],
    });
    return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
  }
  const ys = d3.extent(rows, (d) => d.v);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 380, width: 900, marginLeft: 60,
    color: {legend: true},
    x: {label: null, type: "utc"},
    y: {label},
    marks: [
      ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: Math.min(ys[0], ref ?? ys[0]), y2: ys[1], from, to}),
      ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: Math.min(ys[0], ref ?? ys[0]), y2: ys[1], from, to}),
      Plot.lineY(rows, {x: "_t", y: "v", stroke: "market", z: "seg"}),
      Plot.dot(rows, {x: "_t", y: "v", fill: "market", r: 2, tip: true}),
      ...(ref != null ? [Plot.ruleY([ref], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: "3"})] : [Plot.ruleY([0])]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
totChart = {
  if (!totRows.length) return md`${_lang(nbText.sections.b3.totNoData)}`;
  const from = d3.min(totRows, (d) => d.t), to = d3.max(totRows, (d) => d.t);
  if (totAgg !== "Monthly line") {
    const bucket = (d) => totAgg === "Yearly bars"
      ? Date.UTC(d.year, 0, 1)
      : Date.UTC(d.year, Math.floor((d.month - 1) / 3) * 3, 1);
    const step = totAgg === "Yearly bars" ? [1, 0] : [0, 3];
    const dataEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(to.getUTCFullYear(), to.getUTCMonth() + 1, 1));
    const agg = [...d3.rollup(totRows, (v) => ({v: d3.mean(v, (d) => d.tot), n: v.length}), bucket)]
      .map(([t0, o]) => {
        const d0 = new Date(t0);
        const xEnd = new Date(Date.UTC(d0.getUTCFullYear() + step[0], d0.getUTCMonth() + step[1], 1));
        return {x1: d0, x2: xEnd > dataEnd ? dataEnd : xEnd, partial: xEnd > dataEnd,
          v: o.v, n: o.n};
      }).sort((a, b) => a.x1 - b.x1);
    const yHi = d3.max(agg, (d) => d.v);
    const chart = Plot.plot({
      height: 340, width: 900, marginLeft: 55,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null},
      y: {label: `kg of maize one goat buys — mean per ${totAgg === "Yearly bars" ? "year" : "quarter"}`, grid: true},
      marks: [
        ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: 0, y2: yHi, from, to}),
        ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: 0, y2: yHi, from, to}),
        Plot.rect(agg, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: () => 0, y2: "v", inset: 1,
          fill: "#7b3294", fillOpacity: (d) => d.partial ? 0.45 : 0.75, stroke: "#5a2270", strokeWidth: 0.5, tip: true,
          title: (d) => `${d.x1.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}: one goat ≈ ${d.v.toFixed(0)} kg maize (mean of ${d.n} months${d.partial ? " — period still incomplete" : ""})`}),
        Plot.ruleY([totMedian], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
      ],
    });
    return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
  }
  const ys = d3.extent(totRows, (d) => d.tot);
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 340, width: 900, marginLeft: 55,
    x: {type: "utc", label: null},
    y: {label: "kg of maize one goat buys", grid: true},
    marks: [
      ...bgMarks({x: "date", y1: 0, y2: ys[1], from, to}),
      ...simMarks({x: "date", y1: 0, y2: ys[1], from, to}),
      Plot.lineY(totRows, {x: "t", y: "tot", stroke: "#7b3294", strokeWidth: 1.6, z: "seg", tip: true,
        title: (d) => `${String(d.ym)}: one goat ≈ ${d.tot.toFixed(0)} kg maize`}),
      Plot.ruleY([totMedian], {stroke: "#555", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
rwChart = {
  const data = rwByYear.filter((d) => d.year >= 2010);
  const yEnd = d3.max(data, (d) => d.year) ?? 2026;
  // stacked yearly totals per year (linear x so the driver background can
  // overlay — V2-56's shared system replaces the old tercile strip here)
  const ymax = d3.max([...d3.rollup(data, (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.n), (d) => d.year)].map(([, n]) => n)) ?? 1;
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    height: 300, width: 900, marginLeft: 90, marginRight: 20,
    x: {domain: [2009.5, yEnd + 0.5], tickFormat: "d", label: null},
    y: {label: "reports"},
    color: {domain: ["Drought", "Flood", "Epidemic", "Other"],
      range: ["#d95f0e", "#4575b4", "#7b3294", "#bbbbbb"], legend: true},
    marks: [
      ...bgMarks({x: "year", y1: 0, y2: ymax, from: 2010, to: yEnd}),
      ...simMarks({x: "year", y1: 0, y2: ymax, from: 2010, to: yEnd}),
      Plot.rectY(data, {x1: (d) => d.year - 0.5, x2: (d) => d.year + 0.5, y: "n", fill: "cat", insetLeft: 7, insetRight: 7, tip: true}),
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${bgLegend()}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// computed county insight — beat 3 (trough of the 2020–23 event window)
insightB3 = {
  const w0 = new Date(Date.UTC(2020, 8, 1)), w1 = new Date(Date.UTC(2023, 2, 1));
  const nd = ndviCty.filter((d) => { const t = new Date(d.date); return t >= w0 && t <= w1; });
  const ip = ipcCty.filter((d) => { const t = new Date(d.reporting_date); return t >= w0 && t <= w1; });
  if (!nd.length || !ip.length) return html``;
  const min = d3.least(nd, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal);
  return insightCard(tpl(_lang(nbText.sections.b3.insight),
    {county, ndviMin: Math.round(min.ndvi_pct_normal), ndviWhen: d3.utcFormat("%b %Y")(new Date(min.date)),
     ipcMax: Math.round(d3.max(ip, (d) => d.max_phase))}));
}
```

```{ojs}
// Freshness guard. Monthly indices normally lag 1-2 months, so only >92
// days (two missed updates) is a hard warning; 62-92 days gets a quiet
// data-through stamp instead (R2 fix — a permanently-on banner trains
// readers to ignore it).
stalenessBanner = {
  if (staleness.level !== "stale") return html``;
  return html`<div class="ke-stale">⚠ The ocean-state data on this page ends
    <b>${staleness.label}</b> — more than two missed monthly updates ago. Check the
    <a href="https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/analysis_monitoring/enso_advisory/ensodisc.shtml">NOAA CPC advisory</a>
    and <a href="https://meteo.go.ke">KMD</a> for the current state before acting on this section.</div>`;
}
```

## `{ojs} title_recent`

```{ojs}
recentDrivers = {
  const panels = [
    {col: "nino34_anom_noaa", name: "ENSO — Niño 3.4 (°C)", color: PALETTE.phase.elnino, thr: 0.5},
    {col: "dmi", name: "Indian Ocean Dipole — DMI", color: "#7b3294", thr: 0.4},
    {col: "wnp_std_mam", name: "Western-V index (read for Mar–May only)", color: "#4d4d8f", thr: 0.5},
  ];
  const rows = drivers.filter((d) => d.year >= 2015)
    .map((d) => ({...d, dmi: d.dmi_hadisst ?? d.dmi_ersst, t: new Date(d.date)}));
  const charts = panels.map((p) => {
    const sub = rows.filter((d) => d[p.col] != null);
    return Plot.plot({
      height: 150, width: 900, marginLeft: 55,
      x: {type: "utc", label: null},
      y: {label: p.name, nice: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.rect([{y1: -p.thr, y2: p.thr}], {x1: () => rows[0].t, x2: () => rows[rows.length - 1].t,
          y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#000", fillOpacity: 0.05}),
        Plot.ruleY([p.thr, -p.thr], {stroke: "#bbb", strokeDasharray: "3"}),
        Plot.lineY(sub, {x: "t", y: p.col, stroke: p.color, strokeWidth: 1.5, tip: true}),
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
      ],
    });
  });
  return html`<div>${charts}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Off-diagonal guard: when ENSO and the IOD disagree in sign, say so and
// show the IOD-conditioned analogue reading beside the ENSO one.
offDiagonalGuard = {
  if (!signalsMixed) return html``;
  const e = selectedOutlookOND;
  const i = selectedOutlookIod;
  const word = (o) => o == null ? "no baseline" :
    o.modal === "Wet" ? `wetter (${o.counts.Wet}/${o.n})` :
    o.modal === "Dry" ? `drier (${o.counts.Dry}/${o.n})` : `near-normal (${o.counts.Near}/${o.n})`;
  return html`<div class="ke-warnbox">${md`${_lang(nbText.sections.b4.offDiagonalWarn)}`}
    <div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:0.95em">For <b>${county}</b>:
    ENSO-state analogues lean <b>${word(e)}</b>;
    IOD-state analogues lean <b>${word(i)}</b>.
    ${e && i && e.modal !== i.modal ? "They disagree — low confidence this season." : ""}</div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
outlookMapOND = {
  const W = 660, H = 580;
  const proj = d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[8, 8], [W - 8, H - 8]],
    {type: "FeatureCollection", features: kenyaA1});
  const path = d3.geoPath(proj);
  const fillFor = (o) => {
    if (!o) return "url(#ke-hatch)";
    const strong = o.share >= 0.75;
    if (o.modal === "Wet") return strong ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : PALETTE.outcome.wetterPale;
    if (o.modal === "Dry") return strong ? PALETTE.outcome.drier : PALETTE.outcome.drierPale;
    return strong ? PALETTE.outcome.near : PALETTE.outcome.nearPale;
  };
  const svgEl = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W).attr("style", "max-width:100%;height:auto;")
    .attr("role", "img").attr("aria-label", "Analogue outlook map for the short rains");
  svgEl.append("defs").append("pattern").attr("id", "ke-hatch")
    .attr("width", 6).attr("height", 6).attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse")
    .attr("patternTransform", "rotate(45)")
    .append("rect").attr("width", 2).attr("height", 6).attr("fill", "#d5d5d0");
  svgEl.selectAll("path.cty").data(kenyaA1).join("path").attr("class", "cty")
    .attr("d", path)
    .attr("fill", (f) => fillFor(countyOutlookOND.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code)))
    .attr("stroke", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? "#111" : "#fff")
    .attr("stroke-width", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? 2.2 : 0.6)
    .append("title").text((f) => {
      const name = gaulToCounty.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code) ?? f.properties.admin1_name;
      const o = countyOutlookOND.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      if (!o) return `${name}: no baseline (not a county, or no 1991–2020 record)`;
      return `${name}: ${o.counts.Wet} wetter / ${o.counts.Near} near / ${o.counts.Dry} drier across ${o.n} analogue years`;
    });
  svgEl.selectAll("path.cty").filter((f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul).raise();
  const legend = html`<div class="ke-leg2" role="img" aria-label="Outlook legend">
    <div></div><div style="text-align:center">drier</div><div style="text-align:center">near-normal</div><div style="text-align:center">wetter</div>
    <div>most analogues agree</div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.drier}"></div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.near}"></div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.wetter}"></div>
    <div>leaning only</div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.drierPale}"></div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.nearPale}"></div>
    <div class="cell" style="background:${PALETTE.outcome.wetterPale}"></div>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#666">hatched = no baseline · based on ${analogueYearsOND.length} analogue years</div>`;
  return html`<div>${svgEl.node()}${legend}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
outlookCard = {
  const o = selectedOutlookOND;
  const f = outlookForecastOND;
  const pipColor = {Wet: PALETTE.outcome.wetter, Dry: PALETTE.outcome.drier, Near: PALETTE.outcome.near};
  const word = o ? (o.modal === "Wet" ? "WETTER" : o.modal === "Dry" ? "DRIER" : "NEAR-NORMAL") : "—";
  const wcolor = signalsMixed ? "#d95f0e" : o ? (o.modal === "Wet" ? PALETTE.outcome.wetter : o.modal === "Dry" ? PALETTE.outcome.drier : "#888") : "#888";
  const nullStat = o ? modalNull(o.n) : null;
  const pct = (x) => x == null ? "—" : x >= 99.5 ? ">99%" : Math.round(x) + "%";
  const fpct = f.phase === "El Niño" ? f.el_nino : f.phase === "La Niña" ? f.la_nina : f.neutral;
  const conseq = o == null ? "" :
    o.modal === "Wet" ? _lang(recentDroughtFlag ? nbText.sections.consequence.wetAfterDrought : nbText.sections.consequence.wet) :
    o.modal === "Dry" ? _lang(nbText.sections.consequence.dry) : _lang(nbText.sections.consequence.near);
  const pips = o == null ? "" : html`<span class="ke-pips">${analogueDotsOND.map((d) =>
    html`<span style="background:${pipColor[d.tercile] ?? "#eee"}" title="${d.year}: ${d.tercile ?? "no data"}"></span>`)}</span>`;
  const chips = analogueDotsOND.map((d) => {
    const evt = namedEvents.find((e) => e.seasons.includes(`OND-${d.year}`));
    return html`<span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:2px 9px;margin:2px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;font-size:12.5px" title="${evt ? evt.blurb.en : ""}">
      ${d.year}${evt ? html`<span style="color:#777"> · ${evt.label.en}</span>` : ""}
      <span style="width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:${pipColor[d.tercile] || "#eee"};display:inline-block"></span></span>`;
  });
  return html`<div style="max-width:620px;border:1px solid #e2e2e2;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;">
    <div style="font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#666;text-transform:uppercase;">short rains (Oct–Dec) · ${county}</div>
    <div style="font-size:13px;color:#444;margin:2px 0 10px;">NOAA CPC ENSO forecast: <b>${f.phase}</b> ${pct(fpct)} (issued ${f.issued ?? "—"}) · latest Niño 3.4 ${currentState.oni != null ? currentState.oni.toFixed(2) + " °C" : "—"} (${staleness.label})</div>
    <div style="font-size:12.5px;color:#555;margin:0 0 8px;">${stateContextLine}</div>
    <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:${wcolor};line-height:1.15;">${signalsMixed ? "MIXED SIGNALS" : `LEANING ${word}`}<span style="font-size:16px;font-weight:400;color:#555;">${signalsMixed ? ` — on ENSO history alone, leaning ${word.toLowerCase()}` : " than normal"}</span></div>
    ${signalsMixed ? html`<div style="font-size:13px;color:#a04000;margin:4px 0;">The IOD currently disagrees with ENSO${(() => {
      const i = selectedOutlookIod;
      if (i == null) return "";
      if (i.insufficient) return html` — and the record holds too few such IOD seasons (${i.n}) for a counter-reading`;
      const iw = i.modal === "Wet" ? "wetter" : i.modal === "Dry" ? "drier" : "near-normal";
      return html`; IOD-state analogues lean <b>${iw}</b> (${i.counts[i.modal]} of ${i.n}${i.sameEnso === 0 ? ", all from non-" + f.phase + " years" : ""})`;
    })()}. Treat this season's lean with extra caution.</div>` : ""}
    <div style="font-size:14px;color:#444;margin:6px 0 4px;">${o ? html`${o.counts[o.modal]} of ${o.n} similar past years were ${word.toLowerCase()} ${pips}` : "no 1991–2020 baseline for this county"}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12.5px;color:#666;margin:0 0 8px;">${o ? html`by chance alone the most common outcome would average about ${nullStat.expMax.toFixed(0)} of ${o.n}; ${o.counts[o.modal]} or more happens ${Math.round(nullStat.pGE(o.counts[o.modal]) * 100)}% of the time by chance` : ""} — small samples shift odds, never guarantee</div>
    ${conseq ? html`<div style="font-size:13.5px;color:#333;border-top:1px solid #eee;padding-top:8px;margin-bottom:8px">${conseq}</div>` : ""}
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#666;margin-bottom:4px;">the analogue years:</div>
    <div>${chips}</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#666;border-top:1px solid #eee;padding-top:8px;margin-top:10px">History-based guidance, not a rainfall forecast — the official Kenyan seasonal forecast is <a href="https://meteo.go.ke">KMD's</a>.${calendarAlignLine}</div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
corrMap = {
  const W = 620, H = 540;
  const data = corrByCounty; // Map gaul -> {r, n, p}
  const proj = d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[8, 8], [W - 8, H - 8]],
    {type: "FeatureCollection", features: kenyaA1});
  const path = d3.geoPath(proj);
  const color = d3.scaleDiverging([-0.8, 0, 0.8], d3.interpolateBrBG); // + = wetter with +index = teal
  const svgEl = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W).attr("style", "max-width:100%;height:auto;")
    .attr("role", "img").attr("aria-label", "County correlation map");
  svgEl.selectAll("path").data(kenyaA1).join("path")
    .attr("d", path)
    .attr("fill", (f) => {
      const s = data.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      if (!s) return "#f0f0ec";
      return s.p > 0.05 ? "#dcdcd8" : color(s.r);
    })
    .attr("stroke", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? "#111" : "#fff")
    .attr("stroke-width", (f) => +f.properties.gaul1_code === selGaul ? 2 : 0.6)
    .append("title").text((f) => {
      const name = gaulToCounty.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code) ?? f.properties.admin1_name;
      const s = data.get(+f.properties.gaul1_code);
      return s ? `${name}: r = ${s.r.toFixed(2)}, n = ${s.n}, p ${s.p < 0.001 ? "< 0.001" : "= " + s.p.toFixed(3)}${s.p > 0.05 ? " (not significant)" : ""}`
               : `${name}: no data`;
    });
  const legend = Plot.legend({color: {type: "diverging", domain: [-0.8, 0.8],
    interpolate: (t) => d3.interpolateBrBG(t), label: `correlation r (${corrDriverPick} vs ${corrSeasonPick.includes("OND") ? "OND" : "MAM"} rainfall anomaly)`}, width: 340});
  return html`<div>${svgEl.node()}${legend}
    <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#666">grey = not significant at p&lt;0.05 · n = ${d3.min([...data.values()], (s) => s.n)}–${d3.max([...data.values()], (s) => s.n)} seasons per county · no multiple-testing correction — read the spatial pattern, not single counties</div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
calendarStrip = {
  if (!calCty.length) return md`${_lang(nbText.sections.b2.calendarNoData)}`;
  const mn = ["", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  // expand possibly year-wrapping windows into [start, end] month segments
  const segs = [];
  for (const r of calCty) {
    const lab = `${r.crop} — ${r.season}`;
    if (r.m_end >= r.m_start) segs.push({lab, stage: r.stage, x1: r.m_start - 0.45, x2: r.m_end + 0.45});
    else { // wraps the year end
      segs.push({lab, stage: r.stage, x1: r.m_start - 0.45, x2: 12.45});
      segs.push({lab, stage: r.stage, x1: 0.55, x2: r.m_end + 0.45});
    }
  }
  const labs = [...new Set(segs.map((d) => d.lab))];
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 70 + labs.length * 26, width: 860, marginLeft: 210,
    x: {domain: [0.5, 12.5], ticks: d3.range(1, 13), tickFormat: (m) => mn[m], label: null},
    y: {domain: labs, label: null},
    color: {domain: ["Planting", "Harvest"], range: ["#a8d5a2", "#2E7636"], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([{x1: 2.55, x2: 5.45}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#1b9e77", fillOpacity: 0.06}),
      Plot.rect([{x1: 9.55, x2: 12.45}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "#d95f0e", fillOpacity: 0.06}),
      Plot.barX(segs, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y: "lab", fill: "stage", rx: 2, insetTop: 4, insetBottom: 4,
        tip: {format: {x1: false, x2: false}}}),
    ],
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
tradeMap = {
  const kenC = centroidByIso["KEN"];
  const links = xbtFlows.map((f) => {
    const c = centroidByIso[f.partner_iso3];
    if (!c || !kenC) return null;
    const imp = f.direction === "Import";
    return {...f, x1: imp ? c[0] : kenC[0], y1: imp ? c[1] : kenC[1],
                  x2: imp ? kenC[0] : c[0], y2: imp ? kenC[1] : c[1]};
  }).filter((d) => d != null);
  const maxQ = d3.max(links, (d) => d.qty) || 1;
  const nodes = [...new Set(xbtFlows.map((f) => f.partner_iso3))]
    .map((iso) => ({iso, c: centroidByIso[iso]})).filter((d) => d.c);
  // crop to the trading neighbourhood only (no Madagascar/dead ocean)
  const isoKeep = new Set(["KEN", ...nodes.map((n) => n.iso)]);
  const domain = {type: "FeatureCollection",
    features: africaFeatures.filter((f) => isoKeep.has(f.properties.iso3))};
  const wFor = (q) => 1 + 7 * Math.sqrt(q / maxQ);
  const legQ = [maxQ, maxQ / 4, maxQ / 16];
  const legend = html`<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#555;margin-top:4px">arrow width:
    ${legQ.map((q) => html`<span style="margin-right:14px"><svg width="46" height="10"><line x1="2" y1="5" x2="44" y2="5" stroke="#888" stroke-width=${wFor(q)}/></svg> ${d3.format("~s")(q)} ${xbtUnit}</span>`)}</div>`;
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    projection: {type: "mercator", domain, inset: 24}, width: 760, height: 560,
    color: {domain: ["Import", "Export"], range: ["#d95f0e", "#238b45"], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(domain.features, {stroke: "#d0d0d0", fill: "#f6f6f4"}),
      Plot.geo(domain.features.filter((f) => f.properties.iso3 === "KEN"), {fill: "#e6efe6", stroke: "#333"}),
      Plot.arrow(links, {x1: "x1", y1: "y1", x2: "x2", y2: "y2", stroke: "direction",
        strokeWidth: (d) => wFor(d.qty), bend: 18, headLength: 9,
        tip: true, title: (d) => `${d.direction}: ${d.partner}\n${d3.format(",.0f")(d.qty)} ${d.unit}`}),
      Plot.dot(nodes, {x: (d) => d.c[0], y: (d) => d.c[1], r: 3, fill: "#333"}),
      Plot.text(nodes, {x: (d) => d.c[0], y: (d) => d.c[1], text: (d) => d.iso,
        dy: -8, fontWeight: 600, fill: "#333"}),
    ],
  });
  return html`<div>${chart}${legend}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
datasetCards = {
  const base = "/data/KE-enso-explorer/";
  const atlasCite = _lang(nbText.sections.downloads.atlasCite);
  const cards = datasetRegistry.map((d) => {
    const links = [d.file, ...(d.also ?? [])].map((f) =>
      html`<a class="dataset-download-btn" href="${base + f}" download>${f}</a>`);
    const copyBtn = html`<button type="button" class="dataset-copy-btn">Copy citation</button>`;
    const citation = `${d.src} Accessed via: ${atlasCite}`;
    copyBtn.onclick = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation);
    return html`<article class="dataset-card">
      <header><h3 class="dataset-title">${d.name}</h3></header>
      <p class="dataset-description">${d.desc}</p>
      <div class="dataset-cite"><b>Cite the source:</b> ${d.src}<br>
        <b>and the Atlas:</b> ${atlasCite}</div>
      <footer class="dataset-actions">${links}${copyBtn}</footer>
    </article>`;
  });
  return html`<div>${cards}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// ---- climateRationale figure machinery (inlined; see cycle-3 recon) ----
loaderContent = (stage = "Loading data…") => html`
  <div class="atlas-loader" style="min-height: 420px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 12px;">
    <div style="width: 220px; height: 4px; background: #e8e8e8; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; position: relative;">
      <div style="position: absolute; height: 100%; width: 40%; background: #2E7636; border-radius: 2px; animation: atlas-loader-slide 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="color: #666; font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic;">${stage}</div>
    <style>@keyframes atlas-loader-slide { 0% { left: -40%; } 100% { left: 100%; } }</style>
  </div>`
loaderTarget = (id, stage) => html`<div id="${id}">${loaderContent(stage)}</div>`
renderToDiv = (id, render) => {
  const div = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!div) return;
  div.replaceChildren(render());
}
noDataPlaceholder = (msg = "No data available for the plot") => html`
  <div style="width: 100%; max-width: 900px; height: 300px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 4px; color: #666; font-size: 15px;">${msg}</div>`
multiLineText = (lines, cls = "atlasFigCaption") => htl.html`${lines.map(
  (line, i) => htl.html`<span class="${cls}">${line}</span>${i < lines.length - 1 ? htl.html`<br>` : ""}`)}`
convertToCSV = (data) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) return "";
  const cols = Object.keys(data[0]);
  const esc = (v) => {
    const x = v == null ? "" : String(v);
    return /[",\n\r]/.test(x) ? '"' + x.split('"').join('""') + '"' : x;
  };
  return [cols.join(",")].concat(data.map((r) => cols.map((c) => esc(r[c])).join(","))).join("\r\n");
}
downloadCsvBtn = (data, filename, label = "Download CSV") =>
  Inputs.button(label, {reduce: () => {
    const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff", convertToCSV(data)], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;"});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = filename + ".csv";
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }})
treemapTextColor = (bg) => {
  const rgb = d3.color(bg).rgb();
  const f = (c) => { const x = c / 255; return x <= 0.03928 ? x / 12.92 : Math.pow((x + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); };
  const L = 0.2126 * f(rgb.r) + 0.7152 * f(rgb.g) + 0.0722 * f(rgb.b);
  return L > 0.55 ? "#000" : "#fff";
}
treemapTextLayout = (w, h, labelLen, valueLen, maxBase = 14) => {
  const availW = Math.max(0, w - 12), availH = Math.max(0, h - 6);
  if (availW < 18 || availH < 12) return {showLabel: false, showValue: false, labelSize: 0, valueSize: 0};
  const fitW = (n) => availW / Math.max(1, n * 0.55);
  const labelSize = Math.min(fitW(labelLen), availH * 0.55, maxBase);
  const valueSize = Math.min(fitW(valueLen), labelSize * 0.85);
  const MIN = 6.5;
  const showLabel = labelSize >= MIN;
  const showValue = showLabel && valueSize >= MIN && labelSize * 1.3 + valueSize * 1.2 <= availH;
  return {showLabel, showValue, labelSize: Math.round(labelSize * 10) / 10, valueSize: Math.round(valueSize * 10) / 10};
}
// categorical palette with overflow interpolation (never cycle colours)
paletteRange = (n) => {
  const base = d3.schemeTableau10;
  return n <= base.length ? base.slice(0, n)
    : d3.quantize(d3.piecewise(d3.interpolateRgb.gamma(2.2), base), n);
}
```

```{ojs}
// ---- driver framework (VERBATIM conventions from dev_rainfall_maps.qmd —
// the map session is the source of truth; do not fork bounds) ----
seasonMonthsFor = ({OND: [10, 11, 12], MAM: [3, 4, 5]})

  "ENSO (Niño 3.4)":  {members: ["nino34_anom_noaa"], pos: "El Niño", neg: "La Niña"},
  "IOD (DMI)":        {members: ["dmi"],      pos: "+IOD",    neg: "−IOD"},
  "Western-V (WNP)":  {members: ["wnp_std_mam"],      pos: "High Western-V", neg: "Low Western-V", seasons: ["MAM"]},
  "Season rainfall (county)":      {members: ["__rain__"], pos: "Wet season", neg: "Dry season"},

  const src = col === "dmi" ? driversCoal : drivers;

roniZOnd = {

    if (r.season === "OND" && r.roni_conc != null && !yrs.has(r.year)) yrs.set(r.year, r.roni_conc);

countyZ = (kind, season) => {

  const rows = (kind === "__spei__"
    ? speiSeasonAll.filter((d) => d.period === season && d.value != null)
    : chirpsYearlyAll.filter((d) => d.period === season && d.value != null));
  const ref = rows.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020).map((d) => d.value);

}
zSeriesCache = new Map()

// Ocean drivers: centred windows from the monthly indices, members averaged
// then re-standardized (mirrors zSeries). County rain/SPEI: chirps_county's
// twelve rolling periods ARE these windows (END-year labelled, rollCentre).
// DEVIATION (documented): monthly ENSO uses the plain Niño3.4 windows —
// there is no monthly RONI served (V2-23) — while the Discrete season
// blocks keep RONI for OND ENSO; categories can differ near thresholds.
countyRollingAll = dbChirps.query(`
  SELECT variable, period, year, value_mean AS value FROM chirps_county
  WHERE ${normExpr("admin1_name")} = '${countyNorm(county)}'
    AND variable IN ('PTOT', 'SPEI-03') AND period != 'annual'`)
zMonthlyCache = new Map()
zMonthly = (driver) => {
  const key = driver + "|" + county;
  if (zMonthlyCache.has(key)) return zMonthlyCache.get(key);
  const def = phaseDefs[driver];
  const mk = (y, m) => `${y}-${m}`;
  let out;
  if (def.members[0] === "__spei__" || def.members[0] === "__rain__") {
    const wantVar = def.members[0] === "__spei__" ? "SPEI-03" : "PTOT";
    const rows = countyRollingAll.filter((d) => d.variable === wantVar && d.value != null && rollCentre[d.period]);
    // BOTH variables are re-standardized per rolling window over 1991–2020.
    // County-mean SPEI is NOT ~N(0,1): spatial averaging compresses its
    // variance (measured per-window sd 0.56–0.89), so serving it "as-is"
    // would systematically under-warn on the shared ±2 colour ramp.
    // (All remaining periods have year offset 0, so label year = centre
    // year and the 1991–2020 ref covers the centre months exactly.)
    out = new Map();
    for (const [period, v] of d3.group(rows, (d) => d.period)) {
      const ref = v.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020).map((d) => d.value);
      const m0 = d3.mean(ref), sd = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
      for (const d of v) out.set(mk(d.year + rollCentre[period][1], rollCentre[period][0]), (d.value - m0) / sd);

    zMonthlyCache.set(key, out);

  }
  // ocean drivers
  const memberMaps = def.members.map((col) => {
    const src = col === "dmi" ? driversCoal : drivers;
    const val = new Map(src.filter((d) => d[col] != null).map((d) => [mk(d.year, d.month), d[col]]));
    // centred rolling 3-month mean, all 3 months required (no partial windows)
    const win = new Map();
    for (const [k] of val) {
      const [y, m] = k.split("-").map(Number);
      const prev = m === 1 ? val.get(mk(y - 1, 12)) : val.get(mk(y, m - 1));
      const next = m === 12 ? val.get(mk(y + 1, 1)) : val.get(mk(y, m + 1));
      const cur = val.get(k);
      if (prev != null && next != null && cur != null) win.set(k, (prev + cur + next) / 3);
    }
    // standardize per calendar month over 1991–2020
    const z = new Map();
    for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
      const ks = [...win.keys()].filter((k) => +k.split("-")[1] === m);
      const ref = ks.filter((k) => { const y = +k.split("-")[0]; return y >= 1991 && y <= 2020; })
        .map((k) => win.get(k));
      const m0 = d3.mean(ref), sd = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;

    if (zs.every((z) => z != null && !Number.isNaN(z))) raw.set(k, d3.mean(zs));
  }
  if (memberMaps.length > 1) {
    // re-standardize the composite per calendar month (mirrors zSeries)
    out = new Map();
    for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
      const ks = [...raw.keys()].filter((k) => +k.split("-")[1] === m);
      const ref = ks.filter((k) => { const y = +k.split("-")[0]; return y >= 1991 && y <= 2020; })

zSeries = (driver, season) => {

  if (def.members[0] === "__spei__" || def.members[0] === "__rain__") {
    const out0 = countyZ(def.members[0], season);
    zSeriesCache.set(key, out0);
    return out0;
  }
  const maps = def.members.map((c) =>
    c === "nino34_anom_noaa" && season === "OND" ? roniZOnd : zByYear(c, mons));
  const raw = new Map();
  for (const y of maps[0].keys()) {
    const zs = maps.map((m) => m.get(y));
    if (zs.every((z) => z != null && !Number.isNaN(z))) raw.set(y, d3.mean(zs));
  }
  const ref = [...raw].filter(([y]) => y >= 1991 && y <= 2020).map(([, v]) => v);
  const m = d3.mean(ref), sd = d3.deviation(ref) || 1;
  const out = new Map([...raw].map(([y, v]) => [y, (v - m) / sd]));

categoryOf = (driver, z) => {
  if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return "—";
  const def = phaseDefs[driver], a = Math.abs(z);
  if (a < Z_BANDS.weak) return "Neutral";
  const intensity = a >= Z_BANDS.strong ? "Strong" : a >= Z_BANDS.moderate ? "Moderate" : "Weak";

}
cardColor = (z) => {
  if (z == null || Number.isNaN(z)) return "#ffffff";
  const n = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, z / 2));
  const white = [247, 247, 247];
  const end = n < 0 ? [118, 42, 131] : [27, 120, 55];   // PRGn: purple neg, green pos
  const t = Math.abs(n);
  const mix = white.map((w, k) => w + t * (end[k] - w));

// the SEASON LENS (V2-51): county-specific terciles of the chosen season —

lensSeasonCode = lensSeason.startsWith("OND") ? "OND" : "MAM"
simYearSet = {
  if (seasonLens === "All years") return new Set();

speiIdxOpts = [
  {v: "SPEI-03", label: "SPEI-3 (3-month window)"},
  {v: "SPEI-06", label: "SPEI-6 (6-month window)"},
  {v: "SPEI-12", label: "SPEI-12 (12-month window)"},

// ---- per-plot chart backgrounds (V2-56 cycle 7; V2-45 cycle 8) ----
```

```{ojs}
// ---- planting-season terciles for the selected county (the KMD lens) ----
// enso_outlook_base.year is the season's calendar year = the PLANTING year
// for both OND (plants Oct Y) and MAM (plants Mar Y) — offset 0 everywhere.
tercByYear = (seasonName) => {

// tercile strip (year axis carrier): cells = SEASON OUTCOME
makeTercileStrip = (years, lanes, W = 900, marginLeft = 55, marginRight = 20) => {
  const rows = lanes.flatMap((l) => {

  });

    height: 30 + lanes.length * 16, width: W, marginLeft, marginRight, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 22,
```
